parsed_json.up: Return the list of compounds reported in the specified document. Select the ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, type, and canonical SMILES for each compound. Source the data from the documents, compound records, molecule dictionary, and compound structures tables. Join documents to compound records on document ID, compound records to molecule dictionary on molecule registry number, and molecule dictionary to compound structures on molecule registry number. Filter for the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1151930'. Sort the results by ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
